text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Having some business that required taking the train,
I was heading toward the station when—

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Oh, isn't that Suzuka-san!
That outfit... could it be that you're in the middle of voluntary training?!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Yes. It's a day off and I didn't have any plans,
so I thought I'd run.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Then I'll join you—!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
...is what I'd love to say, but
I already made plans for today,
so I have to head out~!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I'll let you know next time.
Well then, I'm off.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Yes, do your best! ganbare!
Next time, let's de~finitely run together, desu ne~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: After riding the train for about an hour after that—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While finishing up my business,
I somehow spotted Special Week.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Phew~ so full, so satisfied♪ I'm so glad I applied
for that all-you-can-eat sushi lottery, be~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seems by pure coincidence our destinations overlapped,
but coincidences continued to pile up—

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa... phew...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Whoaa~, it's Suzuka-san~♪
Amazing! Meeting twice in a single day!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
...Wait, WHAAAT~?!
Suzuka-san?!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Spe-chan.
Is something wrong?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
S-Something is totally wrong!
Did you seriously run all the way here?!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Eh...? Before I knew it, I'd come this far...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: ...Phew.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Hyaa~... Running into you is surprising enough,
but to think you actually ran all the way out here...!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: I do this sometimes...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Just running endlessly down roads that stretch forever,
getting lost in the ever-changing "scenery"...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Wondering what kind of "scenery"
awaits me further ahead.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: ...And so, I ended up covering quite the distance...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: But that's just so you, Suzuka-san!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Seeing all kinds of "scenery"
is your dream after all, desu ne!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Fufu... that's true.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Toward my dream... I'll keep running forever.
